passages.title: Conference registration
passages.transcript:
N: Questions 32 through 34 refer to the following conversation.
W: Hello, I'm calling to register for the Retail Innovation Conference in Denver.
M: Certainly. Are you registering as an individual or with a group?
W: Three of us from Dunmore Stores. Is there a discount for groups?
M: Yes, groups of three or more get fifteen percent off the regular price of three hundred dollars.
W: That's great. Do you need payment right away?
M: You can pay by credit card now, or send a check within a week.
W: I'll pay now. And could you send the confirmation to my manager as well?

passages.title: Delayed shipment
passages.body:
DELIVERY SCHEDULE — Shipment 4417 (tablets)
Port release:   Wednesday
Customs clearance:   Wednesday midday
Truck to Boston:   same evening if cleared by 2 P.M.
Promotion start:   Thursday, 9 A.M.
passages.transcript:
N: Questions 35 through 37 refer to the following conversation.
M: Hi Gloria, the shipment of tablets hasn't arrived at the Boston store yet.
W: I know. The carrier said there was a delay at the port. They told me it will be released on Wednesday.
M: Wednesday? Our promotion starts on Thursday morning.
W: Don't worry. If it clears customs on time, the truck can reach Boston the same evening. Let me check the delivery schedule.
M: Please do. If it won't make it, I'd rather postpone the advertisement.
W: Let me call the carrier and I'll get back to you within the hour.

passages.title: New hire orientation
passages.transcript:
N: Questions 38 through 40 refer to the following conversation.
W: Welcome to Marlow Insurance, Mr. Dias. I'm Sandra from Human Resources.
M: Thank you. I'm excited to be here.
W: First, let's get your security badge. Then I'll take you to your desk on the fifth floor.
M: Great. Will I get a laptop today?
W: Yes, but IT will set it up this afternoon, so you'll use a temporary one this morning.
M: And when does the safety training happen?
W: Tomorrow at ten. Your supervisor, Ms. Kwon, will meet you for lunch today at noon.

passages.title: Hotel booking problem
passages.transcript:
N: Questions 41 through 43 refer to the following conversation.
M: Good evening. I have a reservation under the name Hoffman for two nights.
W: Let me check... I'm sorry, Mr. Hoffman, but we have you down for tomorrow night, not tonight.
M: That can't be right. I confirmed the dates by email last week, and I'm here for a conference tomorrow morning.
W: I understand. We're fully booked tonight, but I can offer you a room at our sister hotel two blocks away, at the same rate.
M: Will you cover the taxi?
W: Of course, and I'll book your second night here so you don't have to move twice.

passages.title: Office supplies order
passages.body:
OFFICEMART — PRICE LIST
Printer paper (box of 5 reams)   $28.00
Toner cartridge, single   $62.00
Toner pack of 4   $236.00
Toner pack of 10   $550.00
Toner pack of 20   $1,040.00
Staples (box)   $3.50
passages.transcript:
N: Questions 44 through 46 refer to the following conversation.
W: Tom, we're almost out of printer paper. I'm going to place an order with OfficeMart.
M: Good idea. Order the same box size as last time, and add toner cartridges, please.
W: Okay. Let me look at their price list. Toner comes in packs of different sizes, and the bigger the pack, the cheaper each cartridge is.
M: We use about eight a year, so let's get the smallest pack that covers that.
W: Agreed. I'll also include a box of staples.
M: Perfect. Send me the total before you confirm so I can approve it.

passages.title: Presentation preparation
passages.transcript:
N: Questions 47 through 49 refer to the following conversation.
M: Aisha, are you ready for tomorrow's presentation to the board?
W: Almost. I still need to add the sales chart for the last quarter. But I can't find the final numbers.
M: They're in the report from the finance team. I'll forward it to you now.
W: Thanks. I'm also worried about the length. The board only gave us fifteen minutes.
M: Then cut the section about the old product line. They already know that.
W: Good point. I'll practice with a timer tonight.

passages.title: Software training request
passages.transcript:
N: Questions 50 through 52 refer to the following conversation.
W: Hi Victor, I heard the sales team is switching to the new customer database next month.
M: That's right. Everyone has to complete the online training before the end of the week.
W: How long does it take? I have client visits all week.
M: About two hours. You can do it in two sessions. The first covers searching records, the second covers reports.
W: Do I need a special login?
M: Your normal company login works. I'll email you the link now.

passages.title: Event catering
passages.transcript:
N: Questions 53 through 55 refer to the following conversation.
M: Hi, I'm organizing a staff luncheon for forty people next Friday. Do you have a menu for groups?
W: We do. We offer three packages: sandwiches, a hot buffet or a salad bar. The buffet is our most popular.
M: Our budget is about twenty dollars per person.
W: In that case, the sandwich package at fifteen dollars would be best. Dessert and drinks would be five dollars extra.
M: That works. Can you deliver to our office on Harper Street?
W: Yes, with a delivery fee of fifty dollars. I'll send a written quote by email this afternoon.

passages.title: Airport check-in
passages.body:
DEPARTURES
Flight   Destination   Time   Gate
612   Lisbon   10:05   A4
614   Madrid   11:20 (delayed)   C8
618   Paris   11:45   B3
620   Rome   12:10   D2
passages.transcript:
N: Questions 56 through 58 refer to the following conversation.
W: Good morning. I'm flying to Madrid on flight 614. Can I check in here?
M: Yes, ma'am. May I see your passport? ... I'm sorry, flight 614 has been moved to a different gate, and there's a delay.
W: How long will it be delayed?
M: About an hour. It's now scheduled for 11:20. You'll board at Gate C8 instead of B3.
W: Okay. I have a connection in Madrid, so that worries me.
M: I can print a letter for your connecting airline explaining the delay.

passages.title: Small business loan
passages.transcript:
N: Questions 59 through 61 refer to the following conversation.
M: Good afternoon. I'd like some information about a small business loan.
W: Certainly. What will the money be used for?
M: I'm opening a bakery and I need to buy two ovens and rent a space.
W: For a new business we usually require a business plan and two years of personal tax records.
M: I have both. How long does approval take?
W: About ten business days. If you apply this week, we can schedule an appointment with a loan officer on Monday.

passages.title: Apartment repair
passages.transcript:
N: Questions 62 through 64 refer to the following conversation.
W: Hello, this is Mina in apartment 3B. The kitchen faucet has been leaking since Monday.
M: I'm sorry to hear that. I'll send our maintenance person, Carlos. Are you home during the day?
W: I work from nine to five. I could leave a key with the neighbor.
M: That's fine. Carlos can come tomorrow morning between nine and noon.
W: Thank you. Will there be a charge?
M: No, plumbing repairs are covered by your lease.

passages.title: Sales targets
passages.transcript:
N: Questions 65 through 67 refer to the following conversation.
M: Have you seen the numbers for the third quarter, Elena?
W: I have. We're at ninety-two percent of our target, mostly because of the slow July.
M: The new advertising campaign started in August, though. That should help in the last quarter.
W: I think so. The northern region is already ahead of schedule.
M: Then maybe we should shift some of the team to the southern region, where sales are weaker.
W: I'll prepare a proposal and bring it to Monday's meeting.

passages.title: Interview scheduling
passages.body:
INTERVIEW SLOTS — Tuesday
9:00
10:15
11:30
1:30
Candidates: Ortiz, Lee, Patel, Romano
passages.transcript:
N: Questions 68 through 70 refer to the following conversation.
W: Mark, we have four candidates for the marketing assistant position. Can you help me schedule the interviews?
M: Sure. I'm free all morning on Tuesday but I have a meeting at two.
W: Perfect. Ms. Ortiz can only come before noon, and Mr. Lee has asked for the last slot of the day.
M: Then Ms. Ortiz should go first. Let's put Mr. Lee at one-thirty so I can finish before my meeting.
W: Okay. I'll fill in the other two names and email the schedule to everyone.

passages.title: Restaurant reservation
passages.transcript:
N: Questions 32 through 34 refer to the following conversation.
M: Thank you for calling Luigi's. How may I help you?
W: I'd like a table for eight on Saturday at seven. It's for a retirement dinner.
M: I'm sorry, we're fully booked at seven. We have a table for eight at six-thirty or at eight-thirty.
W: Eight-thirty would be better. Do you have a private room?
M: Yes, but it has a minimum spend of four hundred dollars. I can hold it for you until tomorrow noon.
W: Let me check with the other guests and call you back.

passages.title: Car rental
passages.transcript:
N: Questions 35 through 37 refer to the following conversation.
W: Welcome to Express Rentals. Do you have a reservation?
M: Yes, under Greene. I booked a compact car for three days.
W: I see that. We only have a midsize available at the moment, but I'll give you that at the compact price.
M: That's kind of you. Is the fuel tank full?
W: Yes, and you should return it full. Would you like to add insurance?
M: My credit card covers it, so no thanks.

passages.title: Refund request
passages.transcript:
N: Questions 38 through 40 refer to the following conversation.
M: Customer service, this is Raj. How can I help you?
W: I bought a coffee machine from your website two weeks ago, and it stopped working yesterday.
M: I'm sorry about that. Do you have the order number?
W: It's 88-2015. I'd like a refund rather than a replacement.
M: I can do that. Since it's within thirty days, I'll refund the full amount to your card.
W: How long will that take?
M: Five to seven business days. You'll get a confirmation email shortly.

passages.title: Double-booked room
passages.body:
ROOM CHART — Thursday, 10 A.M.
Aspen   Free
Birch   Booked (2 requests)
Cedar   Booked
Dogwood   Free until 12:00
passages.transcript:
N: Questions 41 through 43 refer to the following conversation.
W: Jun, I just realized the Birch room is double-booked tomorrow at ten: my client meeting and your team update.
M: Oh no. Is the Aspen room free?
W: Aspen is too small for my client group, and Cedar is taken. Let me check the chart.
M: I could move my update to the afternoon, but then I'd miss the training session.
W: What if you took the Dogwood room? It's bigger than you need, but it's free until noon.
M: That works. I'll book it now.

passages.title: Expense approval
passages.transcript:
N: Questions 44 through 46 refer to the following conversation.
M: Hi Ayesha, I'm submitting my expense report for the Chicago trip, but the system keeps rejecting the hotel receipt.
W: What error does it show?
M: It says the file is too large. It's a photo from my phone.
W: Try reducing the picture size, or scan it as a PDF. If that doesn't work, email it to me and I'll upload it manually.
M: I'll try the PDF first.
W: Also, remember that any item over one hundred dollars needs a note explaining the purpose.

passages.title: Website redesign
passages.transcript:
N: Questions 47 through 49 refer to the following conversation.
W: Dev, the redesign of our website is due next month. Where are we?
M: The home page and product pages are done. We still have to translate the support section into Spanish.
W: Can the translation agency finish by the fifteenth?
M: They said ten days, so probably yes. But they asked for the final English text first.
W: I'll send it today. Also, the CEO wants a short video on the home page.
M: That could delay the launch. Let's ask her if it can be added after the launch.

passages.title: Furniture delivery
passages.transcript:
N: Questions 50 through 52 refer to the following conversation.
M: Hello, I'm calling about the delivery of a sofa and two armchairs I ordered last week.
W: Let me look it up. Yes, they're scheduled to arrive on Tuesday between noon and four.
M: Unfortunately I'll be at work. Could you deliver after five-thirty instead?
W: Our drivers finish at five, but we have a Saturday morning slot available.
M: Saturday is perfect. Do the drivers carry the furniture upstairs? I'm on the fourth floor, and there's no elevator.
W: There's an extra charge of forty dollars for stairs above the second floor.

passages.title: Rescheduling an appointment
passages.transcript:
N: Questions 53 through 55 refer to the following conversation.
W: Dr. Mehta's office, how can I help?
M: This is Paul Schmidt. I have an appointment tomorrow at three, but my flight was moved and I won't be back until the evening.
W: I understand. The doctor has an opening Friday at nine or next Monday at eleven.
M: Friday works. Do I need to bring anything?
W: Please bring your insurance card and arrive fifteen minutes early to complete a form.
M: Will do. Thank you for rescheduling.

passages.title: Vacation coverage
passages.body:
COVERAGE CHART — Account Managers
Wendell   Brandt accounts (full-time)
Fatima   Available except 17th
Joaquin   Available all dates
Nadia   Team lead
passages.transcript:
N: Questions 56 through 58 refer to the following conversation.
M: Nadia, I'll be on vacation from the twelfth to the twenty-first. Who can cover my customer accounts?
W: Let's see the coverage chart. Wendell is already handling the Brandt accounts, so he's busy.
M: What about Fatima? She's familiar with most of my clients.
W: She is, but she's out on the seventeenth. Hmm. Then Joaquin could cover those days.
M: Good idea. I'll write up notes for both of them before I leave.

passages.title: Factory inspection
passages.transcript:
N: Questions 59 through 61 refer to the following conversation.
W: Mr. Kovacs, thank you for meeting us. The inspectors will arrive on Wednesday at nine.
M: We're ready. The production line was cleaned last week and all safety logs are up to date.
W: Good. They'll also want to see the maintenance records for the packaging machines.
M: Those are with Ms. Reyes in operations. I'll ask her to bring them.
W: One more thing: every visitor must wear protective glasses, including the inspectors.
M: We keep a box of them at the entrance.

passages.title: Marketing budget
passages.transcript:
N: Questions 62 through 64 refer to the following conversation.
M: Linda, the marketing budget for next year is smaller than we hoped.
W: How much smaller?
M: About ten percent. We need to decide what to cut.
W: Print ads are the obvious choice. Our online campaigns bring in more customers per dollar.
M: I agree, but the retail partners still ask for printed brochures.
W: Then let's cut the number of brochures by half and put the savings into social media.
